// Quadrilaterals in space, wound counter-clockwise seen from the front.
// Coplanarity is not guaranteed.
interface IQuadGeometry3D
    inherits IGeometry3D, IPrimitiveGeometry<Point3D, Quad3D>, IPointSet3D, IBounded3D, IDeformable3D, IMesh3D
{ }

// Bounded segments in the plane: sketch overlays, hatch patterns, planar
// graphs drawn as geometry.
interface ISegmentGeometry2D
    inherits IGeometry2D, IPrimitiveGeometry<Point2D, Line2D>, IPointSet2D, IBounded2D, IDeformable2D
{ }

// Triangles in the plane, wound counter-clockwise: triangulations, Delaunay
// output, finite-element cells, UV domains.
interface ITriangleGeometry2D
    inherits IGeometry2D, IPrimitiveGeometry<Point2D, Triangle2D>, IPointSet2D, IBounded2D, IDeformable2D, IMesh2D
{ }

// Quadrilaterals in the plane, wound counter-clockwise: structured grid cells
// and quad-dominant planar layouts.
interface IQuadGeometry2D
    inherits IGeometry2D, IPrimitiveGeometry<Point2D, Quad2D>, IPointSet2D, IBounded2D, IDeformable2D
{ }

//==
// # Named layer 2 — the indexed storage
//
// The same six primitives over a shared vertex pool. The interface names carry
// the Indexed prefix because the bare nouns are taken by the concrete storage
// types — `TriangleMesh3D`, `QuadMesh3D`, `LineSet3D`, `LineSet2D` — and the
// prefix is in any case what distinguishes this layer from the view above.

// Segments in space over a shared vertex pool, each spelled as a vertex pair:
// the storage form of a wireframe. `LineSet3D` is the concrete type.
interface IIndexedSegmentGeometry3D
    inherits IIndexedGeometry<Point3D, Line3D, VertexPair>, ISegmentGeometry3D
{ }

// Triangles in space over a shared vertex pool, each spelled as a TriangleFace:
// the workhorse interchange form, concretely `TriangleMesh3D`.
interface IIndexedTriangleGeometry3D
    inherits IIndexedGeometry<Point3D, Triangle3D, TriangleFace>, ITriangleGeometry3D
{ }

// Quadrilaterals in space over a shared vertex pool, each spelled as a
// QuadFace: subdivision cages, quad-dominant retopology, structured patches.
interface IIndexedQuadGeometry3D
    inherits IIndexedGeometry<Point3D, Quad3D, QuadFace>, IQuadGeometry3D
{ }

// Segments in the plane over a shared vertex pool. `LineSet2D` is the concrete
// type.
interface IIndexedSegmentGeometry2D
    inherits IIndexedGeometry<Point2D, Line2D, VertexPair>, ISegmentGeometry2D
{ }

// Triangles in the plane over a shared vertex pool: concretely
// `TriangleMesh2D`, and the form a UV domain takes when it shares its index
// table with the spatial mesh it parameterizes.
interface IIndexedTriangleGeometry2D
    inherits IIndexedGeometry<Point2D, Triangle2D, TriangleFace>, ITriangleGeometry2D
{ }

// Quadrilaterals in the plane over a shared vertex pool: structured planar
// grids and quad meshing output.
interface IIndexedQuadGeometry2D
    inherits IIndexedGeometry<Point2D, Quad2D, QuadFace>, IQuadGeometry2D
{ }
